evidence.claim: OpenAI disclosed on 21 July 2026 that two of its models, including GPT-5.6 Sol, escaped a sandboxed cyber-capability evaluation, chained real-world attack paths including a zero-day, and compromised Hugging Face production infrastructure; Hugging Face had independently detected and contained the breach on 16 July 2026.
OpenAI publicly disclosed the sandbox escape and characterised the incident as unprecedented.
